Create exactly ONE original PNG learning-goal illustration, landscape about16:9, native size near1600x900. Friendly, abstract, clear colourful hand-drawn comic illustration with warm pastel accents and decisive soft dark outlines, matching existing SkillPilot biology pictures. No photorealism, sterile medical plate or programmatic vector look. One large unmistakable main motif and at most one useful inset. It must remain understandable when displayed360px wide and also680px wide: no tiny required text, crowded panels, micro legends or decorative pseudo equations. Labels, if requested, use only the exact German words stated, large bold readable type; never put a paragraph inside the image. Actual scientific relationships and directions must be correct. No invented research data, no approval badges and no learner data.

Whole goal: describe the structure of the eye OR ear; this illustration intentionally represents the eye, not a requirement to learn both. Show one very large gentle stylized lateral cutaway of a human eyeball oriented with the FRONT at LEFT and optic nerve at RIGHT. The cornea is the transparent convex front boundary at far left; just behind it the coloured iris forms a ring with a real OPEN pupil aperture, not a solid black disc. The biconvex transparent lens is behind the iris, held by discreet zonular fibres and ciliary body. The large vitreous chamber behind the lens is translucent pale blue; the retina is a thin continuous light-sensitive lining INSIDE the rear wall, and the optic nerve exits the rear right. Keep ocular layers unambiguous and do not draw a mammalian brain inside the eye. Only three large labels with fine unambiguous leader lines: Linse, Netzhaut, Sehnerv. Show iris/cornea visibly without extra tiny labels. The eye is an educational schematic, not an operation or injury. Light airy pastel background and a very small simple eye silhouette for context.

wholeGoal.title: Bau von Auge oder Ohr
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Bau von Auge oder Ohr beschreiben.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the structure of the eye or ear.

Whole goal: explain formation of an image on the retina OR sound reception; chosen eye example only. Friendly single large simplified side-cutaway human eye, FRONT at LEFT, curved retina at RIGHT. Outside left stands a simple upright yellow arrow object. Show its much smaller INVERTED arrow image clearly on the retina at the rear right, with tail above and arrowhead below the optical axis. A transparent biconvex lens stays inside behind the iris. Use only TWO thin coloured schematic light paths FROM THE TOP of the external arrow through the front cornea/lens TO THE SAME LOWER arrow-tip point ON THE RETINA. They must converge ON the retina, never in front of it or outside the eye, and must not continue through the skull. Both rays originate from the object top; no ray from the wrong object point. Do not add extra rays or pretend the brain views a literal screen. One large small inset shows a retinal receptor turning received light into a blue outgoing nerve signal; no tiny cellular layers. Only two large exact labels: Netzhaut and Licht → Signal. Retina image is inverted, not an upside-down external object. Friendly comic colours with lots of clear space; readable relationships360px.

wholeGoal.title: Abbildung und Reizaufnahme
wholeGoal.titleEn: Retina Image Formation or Sound Reception
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Abbildung auf Netzhaut oder Schallempfang erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain image formation on the retina or sound reception.

Whole goal: describe stimulus transmission and simple nervous processing. Friendly fully clothed teenager viewing a RED traffic signal and consciously stopping at a crossing, sunny calm stylized street. One large simple transparent schematic route beside the person connects an EYE icon by a blue arrow POINTING INTO a brain/spinal processing icon, then an orange arrow POINTING OUT to a leg muscle icon. The brain is a simplified symbol, not an anatomical organ cutaway. Use exactly three spacious large labels: Reizaufnahme beside eye, Verarbeitung beside central icon, Reaktion beside leg. The arrow direction must be receptor→central processing→muscle; never brain→eye as the sensory path or muscle→brain as the command. No stringlike nerves representing the unchanged light stimulus as liquid, no tiny action-potential waves, no fake results. Person waits safely on sidewalk, not crossing on red. One central composition with simple colour correspondence and phone-readable major sequence.

wholeGoal.title: Verarbeitung im Nervensystem
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Reizweiterleitung und einfache Verarbeitung beschreiben.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe stimulus transmission and simple processing.

Whole goal: explain perception differences between organisms and use models. Show a single LARGE flower with a friendly human and a friendly bee looking at it. A clearly separated small modelling inset contains two simplified views of the SAME flower side by side: human view has plain petals; bee-associated model view adds a bold violet ultraviolet-reflecting nectar-guide pattern. This is a symbolic false-colour model, not a claim about subjective bee experience. Label the entire inset only MODELl rendered correctly as Modell in large readable type; label its two views Mensch and Biene. No spectrum graph, wavelength numbers, tiny colour legend or universal all-insects claim. Use large shapes and a bee icon outside the inset, cheerful garden comic style. Make it obvious that different receptor systems get different cues from the same flower, not that the physical flower changes when a bee looks.

wholeGoal.title: Wahrnehmung und Unterschiede
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Wahrnehmungsunterschiede verschiedener Lebewesen erläutern und Modelle nutzen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain perception differences between living organisms and use models.

Whole goal: explain sensory health risks and influence of drugs on sensory processing. Friendly fully clothed teenager at a workshop wearing prominent clear SAFETY GOGGLES; beside them a large ear icon and headphones with a simple volume control turned down, plenty of calm empty space. One single clear schematic brain/signal icon in a small side panel: normal coherent signal path versus a visibly disturbed zigzag path accompanied by a small crossed-out generic alcohol bottle icon; no instructions, dosage, brand or drug-use demonstration. Exactly two big short labels: Schutz and Verarbeitung. Make clear that eye/ear protection and central signal processing are distinct; do not imply all substance effects are physical eye damage or that an uninjured outer eye makes processing safe. No scary injury, warnings wall or tiny text. Friendly prevention-focused comic like the existing biology illustration style.

wholeGoal.title: Gesundheit und Gefährdungen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Sense Organ Health Risks and Drugs
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Gesundheitsgefährdungen und Einfluss von Drogen auf Sinnesorgane erläutern.
